about.title: About
about.subtitle: Break The Pattern isn't one person. It's a standard.

blocks.d: A brand for repairs, web and tech others wrote off. A founder drives it today; we build it as a team, not a name.
The pattern is settling for average: slow service, generic templates, vague pricing. That's what we break.
Technical services can be fast, honest and excuse-free. Most aren't. We prove otherwise.
Diagnosis first, then the fix. We understand the problem before we solve it.
We're growing. More people, services and projects. The standard stays the same. That's the point.

standards.d: We find the cause first. Then we talk price and timeline, and we hold them.
Components we'll back with a warranty. Not the cheapest substitutes.
Your device comes back cleaner than it arrived. A site is handed over ready to run.

refuse: We don't use templates or page builders.
We don't promise deadlines we can't keep.
We don't bill for work that makes no sense.
We don't fit cheap parts with no warranty.
about.future: BTP is growing from one person into a small team with a clear standard. Same honesty, more hands, more fields, from repairs to websites to harder technical work.
